title: Let AI read your design file, not a screenshot
intro: Three ways to give your AI the real layers, spacing and colours of your design, so the code matches.
reel: From the reel: Designers, stop sending screenshots to AI

tools.name: Figma MCP server
tools.what: Made by Figma. Your AI reads your real frames, layers, spacing and colours, so the code it writes matches the design. The remote server is the one Figma recommends; the desktop server needs a Dev or Full seat on a paid plan.

tools.name: Penpot MCP
tools.what: Penpot is a free, open-source design tool like Figma. Its official MCP lets your AI read and change a Penpot design file. It now lives inside the main Penpot code.

tools.name: Frontend design skill
tools.what: A free skill for Claude from Anthropic. It gives Claude real design guidance, so pages it builds stop looking like every other AI site.

note: The AI builds it. You still decide what looks right.
